    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    # The zeroed cells hide a periodic field inside a background-and-frame pattern.
    palette = [1, 3, 5, 7, 9] if any(9 in row for row in grid) else [1, 3, 5, 7, 2, 4, 6]
